item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find strong 2024 evidence of a Sharif-linked pardon/clemency decision. I also did not find a clean, direct 2024 procurement scandal attributable to Sharif personally; the closest relevant evidence was the power-contract renegotiation, which reads more like cost repair than favoritism. The strongest anti-nepotism evidence is mostly indirect: cabinet composition, family involvement in selection, and continued PM-centered control.
